item.title: Yemeni and Saudi forces launch counteroffensive against Houthis
item.description: Yemeni government forces backed by Saudi Arabia launched a counteroffensive against the Houthis on Sunday to regain territory.

item.title: Iranian diplomats removed from U.S. after defying departure order
item.description: Two members of Iran's UN General Assembly delegation in New York were removed from the country on Saturday, days after being asked to leave.

item.title: New York has a socialist mayor; Los Angeles could be next
item.description: Voters could make history next month by giving the two largest U.S. cities something in common: South Asian immigrant democratic socialists.

item.title: Reflection startup prepares powerful new model to disrupt AI race
item.description: A closely watched Nvidia-backed startup called Reflection is preparing a powerful open-weight system that could threaten the AI race.
